clockBoundary: Stopwatch ticks are helper-local monotonic; Node performance.now is parent-local monotonic. No subtraction across these clock domains. UTC meta timestamps are informational only.

progress.historicalCounterBoundary: Old51/65 and1525139bytes was an observed read prefix. New completion counters advance only after identity checks, encoding, result insertion and handle closure; these are distinct progress boundaries.

observer.nesting: Logging timers overlap; do not add them as independent observer costs. Stage timings include uncalibrated timestamp/counter/wrapper overhead.
